findings.summary: « Не завершено » (90.66 px) truncates at the narrowest roster-showing layout (404 px row) beside a short About label (pdf: 69/91 px), where en fits. It fits at the 1380 px default window and the title is designed to truncate. Measured alternatives: « Не завершён » 82.92 px still truncates, « Не удалось » 71.88 px truncates and drops what failed, « Сбой » 32.67 px fits but claims a fault the English does not. Recorded, left unchanged.

« Загрузите этот навык » keeps the Download button's verb (ui.hub.skills.download = « Загрузить », checked) but carries no direction, and ru also uses « Загрузить » for upload (ui.agents.navigation.legacy.upload = « Загрузить в хаб »), so on a hub skill it can read as 'upload this skill'. Kept the button's verb so the placeholder still names the button, and added the destination « на компьютер ». « Скачайте » was rejected: it would no longer match the button, and the button label lives in ui.hub, whose whole pull vocabulary is « загрузка » (pull_title, installed_alias, not_downloaded), which is outside this delta.
